subject.title: perf(sessions): reuse parsed transcripts for successor rotation

question: Is the bounded, metadata-validated cache reuse sufficiently proven to become the source for successor transcript rotation without an explicit before-and-after RSS measurement?
rationale: The patch has no identified functional defect and strong real-path proof, but it changes an input to persisted session state and omits memory evidence requested by scoped performance guidance.

options.title: Approve After Refresh
options.body: Accept the eight-file and 32 MiB bounds plus differential coverage, refresh onto current main, and land if exact-head checks remain green.

options.title: Request RSS Evidence
options.body: Require a before-and-after RSS or retained-memory measurement before accepting the optimization.

recommendation.title: Approve After Refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the eight-file and 32 MiB bounds plus differential coverage, refresh onto current main, and land if exact-head checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits hardened the cache serialization boundary and refactored the transcript-state seam used by this PR.
